entries.title: B pop
entries.description:
Explosive B Pop Ending with double HE Stack for CT thrown, in order to reposition and damage CT player who plays there.

Then, B entry flash is thrown by 1 player and 3 players entry B Site even through CTs' smoke, while 1 optionally lurks at Second Mid.

Most commonly done in the middle or in the late round.

 Banana Player: 
0:00 @FILAS 
Goes to Top Banana and calls that he is ready

When CTs' Fallen smoke fades and everyone calls they are ready - calls "HE"

When our 2nd CT HE explodes - calls "GO"

Entries B Site first with our flash, goes even through CTs' smoke and continues to Pool

Clears B Site and secures the site
